blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines’ ongoing free trade negotiations with major markets, including the European Union (EU) and Canada, will proceed as planned despite the departure of the country’s chief trade negotiator, Trade Secretary Cristina Roque said. On Wednesday, President Marcos appointed Trade Undersecretary Allan Gepty, who serves as the country’s chief trade negotiator, as one […]...
